blog_title: ₹40 Polyester T-Shirt for DTF Printing — Why 300 Pcs Bubbled and 50 Orders Got Returned
caption:
₹40 tee + DTF print = ₹40k loss. Here's why. 😬

He ordered 300 cheap blanks. After 2 washes, prints bubbled. 50 customers returned. The math: ₹40 blank + ₹80 print = ₹120 lost per return.

Why? No bio-wash, no pre-shrink, polyester mix that won't hold ink.

Check these 3 things before your next bulk order: GSM 180+, 100% cotton, bio-wash + pre-shrink. ₹85 blanks = zero returns.

Save this if you print for profit 👇
